policy: Destroyed and rejected ideas remain permanently recorded so that renamed versions are not repeatedly rediscovered.

entries.title: Constraint Curvature
entries.reason: No mathematical object, update rule, decision threshold, computational model, or falsification condition was defined. The phrase was a metaphor rather than a hypothesis.
entries.salvage: Any descendant must define an explicit invariant and show that it is not merely a renamed SAT decision procedure.

entries.title: Closed Trajectory Field Criterion
entries.reason: No canonical field construction was supplied, and arbitrary fields can be chosen to force either outcome. The criterion was not invariant under equivalent CNF representations.
entries.salvage: A descendant would need a unique polynomial-time field construction and a proof of representation invariance.

entries.title: Universal Formula Invariant
entries.reason: Stating that a polynomial-time invariant separates SAT from UNSAT simply restates P = NP unless the invariant is independently defined and its computation is proved polynomial.
entries.salvage: Register only a concrete invariant with an explicit algorithm and independent mathematical motivation.

entries.title: Clause Resonance Spectrum
entries.reason: The proposed matrix spectrum was not shown to be complete for satisfiability, and no exact separation theorem or counterexample-resistant formulation was provided.
entries.salvage: A future spectral hypothesis must define the matrix canonically and state an exact theorem that survives equivalent encodings and cospectral constructions.

entries.title: Polynomial Skeleton of the Solution Space
entries.reason: Skeleton, size, construction, and emptiness test were undefined. Without those definitions the statement is another form of the desired algorithm rather than a falsifiable route.
entries.salvage: Descendants must name a representation class, construction algorithm, size measure, and explicit lower-bound attack family.

entries.title: P-N Branching Proves Polynomial SAT
entries.reason: Changing only the branching heuristic inside a complete tree-search framework does not remove known exponential worst-case behavior of tree-like proof systems.
entries.salvage: The historical P-N heuristic remains a finite algorithmic experiment, not an asymptotic proof route.
